headline: GTPL Hathway discloses Key Managerial Personnel contacts for SEBI compliance
hook: Routine regulatory disclosure from cable operator
summary: GTPL Hathway has officially disclosed the contact details of its Key Managerial Personnel to stock exchanges in compliance with Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements. This procedural filing ensures transparent communication channels between the company's designated officials and regulatory authorities. Such disclosures are standard administrative updates mandated for all listed entities. Indian retail investors see no financial or operational impact from this routine compliance filing.
why_it_matters: No financial impact, purely procedural regulatory compliance.
